name: population of phase oscillators (Kuramoto, Ott-Antonsen reduction)

slots.Omega: population of phase oscillators (Kuramoto, Ott-Antonsen reduction)
slots.Xi: complex order parameter z = x + i y = <exp(i theta)>: R^2
slots.C: infinitely many oscillators with a Lorentzian distribution of natural frequencies of half-width Delta, in the frame rotating with their mean; the fluctuations of a finite population enter as noise
slots.R: the order parameter r = |z| and the collective phase arg z
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of K
slots.A: K=2, Delta=0.5; control K in (0.2, 3.0); noise D=0.005

provenance: Y. Kuramoto, Lecture Notes in Physics 39, 420 (1975); E. Ott and T. M. Antonsen, Chaos 18, 037113 (2008)
loss_law: a continuum of neutral states: diffusion along the flat directions (Law 2)

events.kind: degenerate critical mode: 2 directions become critical together; the critical eigenspace is 2-dimensional, not a line

required: 2 directions become critical together, as the twisted modes of a ring of an odd number of cells do by the symmetry of the ring: the write chooses a direction in a 2-dimensional critical eigenspace, not one of two states, and the drift reduced to one coordinate does not describe it. A pitchfork of one component needs the degeneracy lifted, by a difference between the elements that splits the critical eigenvalues by more than the resolution of the continuation.

verdict.stores: a continuum of neutral states (zero mode)
verdict.constructs: degenerate critical mode at K = 1: 2 directions become critical together, and the write chooses a direction in a 2-dimensional critical eigenspace, not one of two states of a pitchfork
verdict.holds: a continuum of neutral states: diffusion along the flat directions (Law 2)
